frameRange.windowMsOrigin: integration interval indexed from the two-second cut; slot zero stores the post-update value at cut + 8 frames
frameRange.eventStepMapping: floor((eventFrame - startFrame) / 8), first solver update consuming the strike

pickupSummary.energyDefinition: Mean square of the two per-Plate pickup channels; effective contributor count is inverse Simpson concentration of these nonnegative energy shares.
pickupSummary.eventWindowDefinition: For each delivered strike with a registered layerId, compare that Plate pickup mean-square with the sum across other Plate pickups during the following 500 ms.
pickupSummary.interpretationLimit: Pickup-component energy is not perceptual salience; summed component energies ignore cross-Plate phase cancellation and cannot establish masking or audibility.
